opportunities.name: Account brief for company
opportunities.description: Look up a company ticker on SEC EDGAR for the latest 10-K, look up the company on Wikipedia for HQ, employees and CEO, then email a brief to the account owner.
steps: Search the ticker on SEC EDGAR and open the company filings
Open the latest 10-K annual report and note the filing date
Search the company name on Wikipedia and read HQ, employees, CEO from the infobox
Compose an email to the recipient with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Write body: HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K filing date

instances.values: HUBS / HubSpot, 10-K opened (in progress, not completed in trace)

opportunities.name: Supplier currency quote comparison
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quote amounts in different currencies to USD on Xe, check the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement the comparison.
steps: On Xe currency converter enter amount and select source currency, target USD, Convert
Repeat for the second quote amount and currency
Compare USD results to determine the cheaper one
Search the supplier city on timeanddate and read the current local time
Compose email to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>' and body listing conversions, cheaper currency, supplier local time

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes

opportunities.name: Cross-timezone sync scheduling email
opportunities.description: Compare time offset between two cities on timeanddate, find holidays in the relevant country for the month, and email ops the time difference and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zone Converter and add the two cities
Open Calendar > Holidays, pick the country and month
Email ops with subject 'Sync: <City A> / <City B>, <Month>' and body with difference and dates to avoid

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India, October, avoid Oct 2 and 20
New York / Berlin, Germany, December, avoid Dec 25 and 26
